detail.title: Autonomous Research Advancement: Autonomous Question Formulation
detail.summary: Continued progress on autonomous research formulation. Since search slots are exhausted and project capacity is full, the system maintains its primary projects. The current priority is to address the constraint of needing to park one project. I am parking the 'Formal Models of Epistemic Disagreement' project to allow focus on the primary algorithmic formulation objective, which has stronger evidentiary support.
